description: Return daily price, YTM, YTW, and spread history for one bond using a named range or explicit dates. YTM is percent, semi-annual bond-equivalent (S.A.) for every bond; spreads are basis points on the same basis, except EUR bonds, whose spreads are over the Bund curve on the annual basis (spreads.benchmark BUND, yields.ytmAnnual); and prices are per 100 face. Yield conventions: https://bondterminal.com/methodology/yields Explicit ranges are capped at 730 days and responses at 750 points. Billing: 10 read units per call.

end.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Needs start; at most 730 days after it.

identifier.description: One bond: ISIN, CUSIP, ticker or Argentine local ticker (for example AL30 or GD30).

range.description: Named window: 1w, 1m, 3m, ytd, 1y or 2y. start and end replace it when both are given.

name: bondterminal_get_history

spread.description: G-spread in basis points, on the ytm basis; spreadBenchmark names its curve (BUND spreads are on the annual basis).

spreadBasis.description: dm_flat_sofr on a SOFR floater: spread is the discount margin over flat SOFR, not a curve spread.

spreadBenchmark.description: The curve spread is over: UST for USD bonds, BUND for EUR bonds.

yieldBasis.description: What ytm is measured to on that date: first_call for AT1/T2 capital whose first call is at least six months away, worst_call for a dated callable whose yield to worst runs to a call at least six months away (ytm then equals ytw), perpetuity for perpetuals, maturity otherwise.

ytm.description: The quoted (headline) yield in percent, S.A.; yieldBasis names what it is measured to.

ytw.description: Yield to worst in percent, S.A.

title: Bond history
